item.title: ICE Agents’ Relatives Are Cutting Them Off
item.description: Amid growing reports of brutal immigration-enforcement tactics, the relatives of three ICE agents tell Vanity Fair how their relationships have fractured. In some cases, they’re cutting ties.

item.title: Kate Middleton and Prince William Want to Rule With “More Empathy” and a “Greater Personal Relationship With the People”
item.description: The Prince and Princess of Wales’s approach to ruling will be “incredibly forward-looking,” royals journalist Russell Myers tells Vanity Fair.

item.title: Spylandia: How a Stretch of Florida Real Estate Has Become a Covert Corridor for Chinese and Russian Spies
item.description: The so-called Space Coast, with its rocket launches and military tech, is now an unassuming setting for espionage.

item.title: No Country for Cheap Fuel: Hollywood Faces an Oil Shock
item.description: Experts explain how rising fuel costs will affect Hollywood—and eventually, the films we see.

item.title: Zendaya Wore Her 2015 Oscars Dress to 'The Drama' Premiere
item.description: The Euphoria star and her stylist, Law Roach, dipped into the archives and found a very special dress for the premiere of A24's The Drama, where Zendaya stars as a bride-to-be opposite Robert Pattinson.

item.title: The Parmesan-Eating, Espresso-Swilling Passion of Italian Baseball
item.description: The Italian-Americans of the Azzurri, fresh off an improbable World Baseball Classic run, carry the stories of their grandparents with them. “It’s pride in their origins,” coach Francisco Cervelli tells Vanity Fair. “Like the smell of ragù on Sundays, it keeps us together.”

item.title: Jeffrey Epstein's Lasting Grip on the Gates Foundation
item.description: Newly released emails reveal how the pedophile posing as finance whiz worked to use a think tank in the Gates Foundation's network for everything from Middle East intelligence to visas for young women from Eastern Europe.

item.title: Charlie Hall is the Latest Nepo Baby to Join The White Lotus
item.description: Mike White just announced the cast of his hit show's fourth season

item.title: Mormon Wives Star Taylor Frankie Paul’s Bachelorette Season Canceled By ABC
item.description: “We have made the decision to not move forward,” a Disney spokesperson confirms to Vanity Fair, amid a domestic assault investigation into Paul and her ex Dakota Mortensen.

item.title: Tulsi Gabbard Struggles to Sell Trump's War With Iran
item.description: Trump’s director of national intelligence has spent her career arguing against a war with Iran. Now, she’s the public face for one, and her former allies are furious.
